title: New potato and tomato hash with eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain home staple: potatoes, olive oil, spring onions, tomatoes, eggs, smoked paprika and chives.

supermarket.reason: All the ingredients are everyday items at any mainstream supermarket in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a large frying pan with a lid and simple steam-then-fry and egg-cracking techniques.

works.reason: Steaming quartered new potatoes in a covered pan, frying them, then setting four eggs under a lid gives a sensible hash for four, and any water left over boils off while frying.

honest_times.reason: Sixteen minutes covers quartering the potatoes and chopping the tomatoes, spring onions and chives, and the step timings add up to the printed 20 minutes of cooking.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used in the steps, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: 400g of fresh tomatoes with new potatoes makes a warm, light June breakfast in which the tomatoes are a main component rather than a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear, in British English and easy for a beginner to follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Potatoes, tomatoes, spring onions and an egg each make a filling breakfast of real food that a family would happily eat again.
